# Experience Requirements Checklist: Hosted Guidelines Portal Rebuild

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the hosted portal requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Architecture and Navigation Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are the hosted and portable guideline responsibilities explicitly separated without creating a second source of brand truth? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 to FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are the required topic families and rules for absent authoritative content defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are persistent desktop and disclosed mobile navigation requirements defined with equivalent hierarchy and states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are direct URLs, fragment visibility, no-script traversal, focus, touch, and reduced-motion behavior all specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006 to FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Is host neutrality defined for both page chrome and the dedicated brand’s visual primacy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Are footer control separation, target size, focus, color, and spacing objectively stated? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]

## Color Reference Requirements

- [x] CHK007 Is the resting color row inventory explicit enough to prevent alias-heavy headings or hidden canonical values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Are all secondary color formats, aliases, and print guidance required from one canonical value? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK009 Is disclosure stability defined against unrelated-entry movement, overflow, and focus loss? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Are copy success, copy failure, fallback selection, accessible naming, focus, and hit-target requirements complete? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]

## Asset Library Requirements

- [x] CHK011 Are task-oriented families defined independently of physical storage paths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 Is the distinction between a representative design and its size, format, alias, and destination deliveries unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014 to FR-015]
- [x] CHK013 Are representative preview bounds, titles, usage summaries, and variant summaries required for every visual design? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK014 Are nonvisual resource types and their prohibited blank-preview treatment explicitly covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK015 Are instruction rendering semantics and the secondary role of raw downloads specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK016 Are search, filters, result announcements, resettable empty states, query links, keyboard use, and no-script fallback all specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018 to FR-019]
- [x] CHK017 Are exact inventory coverage, missing-delivery failure, duplicate detection, dead-link prevention, and honest labels required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]

## Responsive and Accessibility Requirements

- [x] CHK018 Are heading containment requirements measurable across every production brand, target width, and zoom level? [Measurability, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK019 Is the two-column failure response bounded to balanced wrapping or a one-column transition that preserves adjacent content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK020 Are long names, aliases, filenames, paths, headings, and malformed previews addressed as edge cases? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard, touch, reduced motion, zoom, encoding, and mojibake requirements stated as non-waivable gates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK022 Are identity geometry, canonical values, generated-kit contents, and `dist/` explicitly excluded from committed change? [Boundary, Spec §FR-027]

## Acceptance and Traceability Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are automated measurements defined for every regression named in the parent and child issues? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK024 Are the five task-based user journeys and all-five-brand review scope objectively defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024 and SC-002]
- [x] CHK025 Do success criteria preserve exact manifest coverage, zero layout instability, heading containment, accessibility, and full-kit verification? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001 to SC-007]
- [x] CHK026 Is issue closure scope explicit for #157 through #161 while #153 remains excluded? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
